verdict.rationale: Isaac includes a deployment stack (Isaac ROS on Jetson), so remote debugging of deployed robots is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence documents no first-party capability for remotely inspecting live topics, logs, or state. The mentions of continuing to use familiar ROS 2 tools refer to host-ecosystem tooling. The teleoperation package is an adjacent feature, not monitoring or debugging, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can inspect live topics, logs, and state on a deployed robot remotely to debug issues
